scope: Final user-workflow inspection of Priming; existing pinned environment and local assets; no new GPU execution, full training, conversion, or bulk downloads.
public_repository_access: Excluded from readiness assessment at user request; publication is planned.
assessment: Packaged workflows pass CPU/source/asset checks. Standalone preparation now accepts compatible perceptual pretraining checkpoints at any saved step through --init-checkpoint; the default released-source identity checks remain intact.

dataset_decoding.sampled_indices: first, middle, last in each split

posttraining_assets.additional_check: L-160 initialization size and SHA256 match training/provenance/sources.json

asset_release_manifest_consistency.scope: Direct shared paths agree with training/assets.json, including allowed published metadata identities.

documentation_fixes: Evaluation quick start explicitly downloads its matching generator checkpoint.
Single-arm post-training verification no longer asks B-only users to supply L checkpoints.
Documented exact external-storage mappings, download-root semantics, and runtime cache overrides.
Evaluation examples preserve configured external cache roots.
Added terminal post-training checkpoint to official evaluation and verification commands.
Linked Woobin Park and Jaeyeon Kim to their supplied author websites.
Documented pretraining-to-post-training handoff at any source step, with frozen checkpoint identity and fresh optimizer/counters.

remaining_limitations.issue: Official standalone evaluation accepts terminal 25000-update post-training checkpoints; reconstruction and intermediate checkpoint evaluation are not exposed by this entrypoint. Sampling is restricted to released checkpoint identities.
Baseline checkpoint destinations are listed, but download/conversion commands for every baseline generator are not supplied. This does not block Priming model training/evaluation.

validated_behaviors: exact online and EMA tensor schemas
online and EMA inherited with fresh optimizer and post-training counters
preparation without released generator checkpoint present
resume does not need the original initialization file

actual_asset_preparation.mode: two-step smoke configuration prepared; GPU training not launched

pipeline_routes.released_priming_sampling: All eight B/L x 80/160 x pre/post checkpoints.
pipeline_routes.released_priming_metrics: All four post-trained Priming checkpoints; official FID/FDr5 commands and verification.
pipeline_routes.pretraining: Three packaged recipes from random initialization.
pipeline_routes.posttraining: Pinned B/L-160 default; explicit compatible perceptual pretraining sources at any step; three B ablation arms.

scope_boundaries: No automatic complete baseline generator/VAE download and Drifting conversion path.
